# Ben Robart – Full Stack Developer

> Full stack developer based in Glasgow, UK. I build websites, online shops, booking systems, and apps – then get them found with SEO/AEO, PPC, social media, and email marketing. Available for freelance projects, and open to the right full-time remote or hybrid role.

Key facts:

- Location: Glasgow, UK (remote-friendly)
- Contact: robartben@gmail.com or +44 7921 835288
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/benr95/
- Pricing: quoted and agreed up front, no percentage-of-budget fees, no lock-in
- Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue, React, Angular, Tailwind CSS, PHP, Python, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android, Wear OS, Health Connect, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Zapier, Airtable

## Services

Full breakdowns at https://benrobart.github.io/#services

- Website Design & Build: Brochure sites, online shops, booking systems, and custom web apps on WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, or a fully custom stack (Laravel, Vue). Mobile-first and accessible, editable by the client, search-ready basics included, no vendor lock-in. Every site is quoted individually.
- SEO & AI Search Visibility (AEO), one-off pass: A single top-to-bottom optimisation: natural-language content, schema tags, FAQ and Q&A blocks, descriptive alt text, EEAT verification, high-intent keyword research, and Google Business Profile set-up or optimisation.
- SEO & AI Search Visibility (AEO), ongoing: Everything in the one-off pass plus monthly performance reports with implementation, behaviour tracking via Microsoft Clarity, decay prevention against algorithm shifts, and competitor monitoring. Optional add-on with either option: two SEO'd and AEO'd blog posts per month.
- PPC Management: Flat management fee rather than a percentage of ad spend. Custom ad assets, high-intent targeting, A/B testing, and continuous optimisation. One full campaign included; additional platforms (Meta, LinkedIn) can be added. Ad budget is separate.
- Social Media Management: Two posts per week with custom graphics and captions in the client's brand voice, collaborative content planning, and community engagement. Additional platforms can be added.
- Newsletter Management: monthly or weekly sends. Design and layout, content integration, list management and deliverability, welcome automations, and open/click reporting. No platform costs until 2,500 subscribers.
- Market & Competitor Research: a report covering the client's market and up to three competitors in depth; more competitors can be added. Competitor profiling, search presence, pricing analysis, gap analysis, and a prioritised list of plain-English recommendations. Ongoing competitor monitoring is included in the monthly SEO service; this report is the deeper one-off version.
- Process Documentation: Step-by-step write-ups in one agreed format, edge cases included, written so a new starter could follow them on day one.
- Workflow Automation: Automations built with Zapier and Airtable (no need to be using either already) connecting forms, bookings, invoices, and spreadsheets, tested alongside the manual process and documented as standard.
- Bundles: SEO and PPC together (one campaign, one platform), or the all-in-one (SEO, PPC, one social platform, a weekly newsletter, and four blog posts per month).

## Selected work

- [Gentle](https://gentle-app.github.io/): a free energy-pacing Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Health Connect) for people with chronic illnesses such as ME/CFS, Long COVID and Crohn's, with a companion Wear OS app and its own website. All health data stays on the phone.
- [Vertex Agility](https://vertexagility.com/): rebuilt the company's main website (PHP, Python, WordPress, JavaScript) with the goal of moving away from vendor lock-in, including an agentic AI assistant.
- [Worthy Women](https://worthywomen.uk): client website build.
- [Aspire Procurement](https://aspireprocurement.co.uk/): client website build.
- [Projects](https://benrobart.github.io/#project): further work, including a leisure park booking system (Laravel, Vue, Tailwind CSS, MySQL), an AI-powered marketing tool integrated with GA4 and Google Search Console that also generates branded documents and graphics, Shopify and WooCommerce stores, and an eLearning WordPress network.
